entities.name: HisZ (Q3AXX8)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Synechococcus sp. CC9902 ATP phosphoribosyltransferase regulatory subunit (UniProt Q3AXX8).
Annotated as required for the first step of L-histidine biosynthesis and possibly enabling histidine feedback regulation of ATP phosphoribosyltransferase activity.
Pfam tRNA-synt_His domain spans residues 8–317; annotation reports association in a heteromultimer with HisG.
Annotated cytoplasmic; retrieved GO assignments include histidyl-tRNA ligase activity, which is discordant with the protein name/function and should be treated cautiously.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: HisZ is annotated as required for the first step of the pathway, in association with ATP phosphoribosyltransferase activity.
The exact sequence-match reference places the protein in the cytoplasm of Synechococcus sp. CC9902.
